scope: Full current reverse switch and rollback test review
assessment: Return to occupied original roots preserves new runs/media, retained backups and explicit active storage binding; old source remains fenced
Object-only return preserves shared workspace and added object; completed recovery readonly for JSON records
Interrupted exchange, intent, fence receipt and configuration sync resume without swapping twice; inactive target cannot start runs
Changed preserved copy, target configuration or activation binding refuses execution without unapproved target creation
Rollback restores source config/runs/artifacts, preserves staging, retries interruption and permits fresh reverse plan
Activated reverse rejects rollback; foreign fence, edited config or modified backup refuses directory restoration
Public CLI switch/resume/rollback verifies explicit source authority
limitations: Injected interruption rather than process termination; process-death matrix reviewed separately
Readonly completed recovery snapshot covers JSON records rather than every media file
Disposable same-filesystem fixtures; real products, cross-volume and browser acceptance remain open
